records.issue_text: New concurrency/synchronization logic in webassets.go has zero test coverage, meaning regressions like deadlocks or data races would surface only in production
records.rationale: The diff introduces new synchronization around a global cache (`entryPointAssetsCacheMu sync.RWMutex` and added `RLock()/Lock()` logic in `GetWebAssets`). This is nontrivial concurrency behavior, and this PR diff shows no accompanying test additions to exercise the new locking/cache behavior, so the concern about missing coverage for potential races/deadlocks is a substantive review point grounded in the change.

records.issue_text: In Dev mode where cfg.Env == setting.Dev bypasses the read cache, every request takes the write lock causing redundant re-load on a thundering herd
records.rationale: In `GetWebAssets`, even when `cfg.Env == setting.Dev` (so the cache is intentionally bypassed), the function still always takes the global write lock (`entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock(); defer Unlock()`), which serializes all concurrent requests through that lock. That creates unnecessary contention in dev mode and can force repeated re-computation under exclusive lock rather than allowing parallel loads or limiting the lock scope.
